svg.text: Student-t likelihood; random effects for site, ecoregion and land cover;
predictor effects vary by forest functional type
Site sets (16-site CHM, 18-site DTM) follow the site-level exclusions of Section 2.1.
footprints (dots) nest in sites and sites in ecoregions;
filled and open dots are two land-cover classes
dashed, site’s own mean; solid, pooled estimate
offset drawn from the shared distribution (3.6)
